question: Should 0.38.4 ship from this combined release branch, or should the dedicated fix PR land first and this branch be rebased to release-only metadata?
rationale: Both branches contain the exact proven fix commit, but only this PR finalizes 0.38.4; selecting release inclusion and merge order is an operator decision that correctness checks cannot make.

options.title: Ship the combined branch
options.body: Confirm 0.38.4 inclusion, merge this PR as the authoritative serialized release branch, and retire the overlapping dedicated fix PR afterward.

options.title: Land the fix first
options.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1090, then rebase this PR to contain only the authorized 0.38.4 release metadata.

options.title: Pause the release
options.body: Keep this PR open without merging until the 0.38.4 contents and publication timing are explicitly approved.

recommendation.title: Ship the combined branch
recommendation.body: Confirm 0.38.4 inclusion, merge this PR as the authoritative serialized release branch, and retire the overlapping dedicated fix PR afterward.

likelyOwner.reason: The same contributor prepared the prior release and authored both overlapping current branches across the release-owned files.
